title: Synchronize branches with GitHub remotes
description: Implement fetch, pull, and push with explicit progress and verified remote state, using only reviewed permissions and credentials.
acceptanceCriteria: Fetch updates remote-tracking state and reports the verified result.
Pull and push show progress, handle authentication/network/rate-limit failures, and never report success before the Git engine confirms it.
Divergent history or unsafe local state is surfaced with a recovery path instead of being overwritten.
Remote write authorization is explicit, narrowly scoped, and tested for denial/revocation.

steps.description: Review remote/auth architecture and permission scope
steps.details: Do not implement until the required write authorization is approved in project specs.

steps.description: Implement fetch, pull, and push flows
steps.details: Keep results bound to repository, remote, and branch identity.

steps.description: Test remote failures and verified success
steps.details: Cover offline, auth, divergence, and successful synchronization.

technicalNotes: Do not place tokens in browser storage, URLs, logs, or prompts.
